title: You Try Forcing Unwanted Thoughts Away, Yet Fighting Them Makes Them Bounce Back Stronger
description:
You think strong willpower can delete unwanted thoughts! Yet pushing a thought down launches it higher! This is the true story of Daniel Wegner's White Bear Experiment. Here is what went wrong with brute mental force.
